system.description:
Whenever a creature is afflicted with the Panicked condition, you can intensify the strength of their fear. This skill can also be used as a Trigger Action.

Trigger: You used Whispering Schemes to apply the Panicked condition on a target. These effects last as long as the target is afflicted with the Panicked condition.

Your target rolls a Magykal Resistance. On failure they are afflicted with the unique Horrified condition. The Horrified condition causes a creatures attacks to deal damage as if they were Poor, regardless of attack roll.
